title: Building and Editing Verbal Sentences
lede: Turn a correct three-part core into fluent, varied Arabic—then use a reliable editing routine to protect word order, agreement, tense and meaning.

items.prompt: Best VSO core for “The students completed the project.”
items.feedback: Verb first before an overt human plural → singular masculine.

items.prompt: Best SVO core for the same meaning.
items.feedback: Human plural subject first → full plural agreement.

items.prompt: Add a manner phrase to كَتَبَتْ لَيْلَى الرِّسَالَةَ.
items.feedback: Add the manner after a secure core.

items.prompt: Negate the past event with لَمْ.
items.feedback: لَمْ takes a jussive present form but refers to the past.

items.prompt: Ask a yes/no question about the event.
items.feedback: هَلْ can precede the complete verbal sentence.

options: Find the verb and identify the intended subject.
items.feedback: Agreement and roles must be secure before stylistic expansion.

items.prompt: You have already mentioned the girls and now say what they did.
items.feedback: Subject-first keeps the known girls as topic and requires full agreement.

items.prompt: Open a report with the event “The train arrived.”
items.feedback: Verb-first is a neutral event-reporting choice.
Subject-first topics create a clear contrast.
لِأَنَّ introduces the reason.
بوضوح answers how.
The core and added details remain clear.

items.prompt: What should be checked after adding a clause?
options: The original subject–verb agreement still holds.
Every sentence now begins with وَ.
items.feedback: Expansion must not damage the core grammar.
Verb-first with overt human plural → singular masculine.
Subject-first human feminine plural → feminine plural verb.
لَمْ requires the jussive present form and expresses past negation.

items.prompt: Repair unclear pronoun: قَرَأَتْ مَرْيَمُ الرِّسَالَةَ ثُمَّ أَرْسَلَهُ.
items.feedback: The subject remains Maryam and the feminine object pronoun refers to الرسالة.
Singular masculine verb before overt masculine/mixed plural.
Human feminine plural subject first requires feminine plural verb فُزْنَ.

items.prompt: Choose the accurate non-human plural sentence.
items.feedback: Non-human plural → feminine singular agreement.

items.prompt: Transform to VSO: الْمُعَلِّمَتَانِ شَرَحَتَا الدَّرْسَ.
items.feedback: Singular feminine verb before feminine dual.

items.prompt: Transform to SVO: يَكْتُبُ الطُّلَّابُ الْإِجَابَاتِ.
items.feedback: Human plural subject first → full plural present.
لَمْ + jussive present, past meaning.
Subject-first human feminine plural → full future agreement.

items.prompt: Which sentence has clear pronoun reference?
items.feedback: ـها refers clearly to the feminine noun الرسالة.

options: To keep a known subject as the topic or create contrast.
items.feedback: Word-order choice serves information focus.
The four-pass routine protects the core before style.

games.p: Repair formal VSO: كَتَبُوا الطُّلَّابُ التَّقْرِيرَ.
games.e: Verb first before overt human plural.

games.p: Add time to the clear core.
Transform to SVO: قَدَّمَ الطُّلَّابُ الْعَرْضَ.
games.e: Moving a human plural subject first triggers full agreement.
Singular feminine future before overt feminine plural.
Roles and agreement come before decoration.

blocks: ## Why this matters مِنَ الْقَاعِدَةِ إِلَى التَّوَاصُلِ
Cambridge performance depends on using structures accurately in meaningful answers, not naming rules in isolation.
### Core
Build clear VSO and SVO cores.
### Develop
Expand and transform sentences across time frames.
### Stretch
Edit sustained writing for focus, agreement and cohesion.
[callout] Final performance: produce a connected account containing deliberate VSO/SVO variety and explain two of your agreement choices.
## Diagnostic start
This check combines the previous three lessons.
## Choose the order for a reason
Both patterns are useful. The best choice depends on what the listener already knows and what you want to foreground.

TABLE: Communicative purpose | Preferred opening | Model // Report a new event | Verb first | فَازَ الْفَرِيقُ بِالْمُبَارَاةِ. // Continue talking about a known person/group | Subject first | الْفَرِيقُ لَعِبَ بِمَهَارَةٍ. // Contrast two topics | Subject first | عَلِيٌّ دَرَسَ، أَمَّا أَخُوهُ فَلَعِبَ. // Narrate a sequence | Often verb first | وَصَلَ الطُّلَّابُ، ثُمَّ بَدَأَ الدَّرْسُ. // Answer “What did they do?” | Subject first can be natural | الطُّلَّابُ أَكْمَلُوا الْمَشْرُوعَ.
[callout] Variety is not random: Do not alternate VSO and SVO merely to appear advanced. Change order when it improves focus, contrast or flow.
## The sentence-building ladder
Build one secure layer at a time and recheck the core after every addition.

TABLE: Step | Sentence | Added information // 1 Core event | كَتَبَ الطَّالِبُ الرِّسَالَةَ. | V + S + O // 2 Time | كَتَبَ الطَّالِبُ الرِّسَالَةَ أَمْسِ. | when // 3 Place | كَتَبَ الطَّالِبُ الرِّسَالَةَ أَمْسِ فِي الْمَكْتَبَةِ. | where // 4 Manner | كَتَبَ الطَّالِبُ الرِّسَالَةَ أَمْسِ فِي الْمَكْتَبَةِ بِعِنَايَةٍ. | how // 5 Reason | كَتَبَ الطَّالِبُ الرِّسَالَةَ ... لِأَنَّهُ أَرَادَ الِاعْتِذَارَ. | why // 6 Link | ثُمَّ أَرْسَلَهَا إِلَى صَدِيقِهِ. | next event + object pronoun
[callout] Object control: In أَرْسَلَهَا , the attached pronoun refers to الرِّسَالَةَ . Make every pronoun reference clear.
## Transform across past, present and future
Keep the order and roles stable while changing the verb system and time expression.

TABLE: Time frame | VSO | SVO // Past | زَارَ الطُّلَّابُ الْمَتْحَفَ أَمْسِ. | الطُّلَّابُ زَارُوا الْمَتْحَفَ أَمْسِ. // Present/habitual | يَزُورُ الطُّلَّابُ الْمَتْحَفَ كُلَّ سَنَةٍ. | الطُّلَّابُ يَزُورُونَ الْمَتْحَفَ كُلَّ سَنَةٍ. // Future | سَيَزُورُ الطُّلَّابُ الْمَتْحَفَ غَدًا. | الطُّلَّابُ سَيَزُورُونَ الْمَتْحَفَ غَدًا. // Future negative | لَنْ يَزُورَ الطُّلَّابُ الْمَتْحَفَ غَدًا. | الطُّلَّابُ لَنْ يَزُورُوا الْمَتْحَفَ غَدًا.
[callout] Editing question: Did you change only the time marker, or did you also rebuild the verb form required by the order and subject?
## Questions and negation preserve the core roles
Particles may come before the verbal sentence, but the subject and agreement rules remain visible.

TABLE: Function | VSO model | SVO model // Yes/no question | هَلْ كَتَبَ الطُّلَّابُ التَّقْرِيرَ؟ | هَلِ الطُّلَّابُ كَتَبُوا التَّقْرِيرَ؟ // Past negative with مَا | مَا كَتَبَ الطُّلَّابُ التَّقْرِيرَ. | الطُّلَّابُ مَا كَتَبُوا التَّقْرِيرَ. // Past negative with لَمْ | لَمْ يَكْتُبِ الطُّلَّابُ التَّقْرِيرَ. | الطُّلَّابُ لَمْ يَكْتُبُوا التَّقْرِيرَ. // Present negative | لَا يَكْتُبُ الطُّلَّابُ الآنَ. | الطُّلَّابُ لَا يَكْتُبُونَ الآنَ. // Future negative | لَنْ يَكْتُبَ الطُّلَّابُ غَدًا. | الطُّلَّابُ لَنْ يَكْتُبُوا غَدًا.
[callout/warning] Do not mix systems: لَمْ كَتَبَ is incorrect because لَمْ requires a jussive present form.
## A four-pass editing routine
Edit one feature at a time so that a long paragraph does not hide a small but important agreement error.

TABLE: Pass | Question | Action // 1 Roles | What is the verb? Who is the intended subject? Is there an object? | mark V, S and O // 2 Order | Does the subject come before or after the verb? | select full or singular-number agreement // 3 Verb form | Does person, gender, number, tense and mood fit? | repair prefix/suffix/end vowel // 4 Expansion | Are pronouns, prepositions, time words and connectors clear? | check reference and logical flow
[callout] Read backwards for agreement: Start at the end of a sentence, find the subject and return to the verb. This interrupts the habit of reading only for meaning.
## Cambridge application without turning grammar into a drill
Sentence control supports comprehension and production across all four papers.
### Reading and listening
Use verb endings and word order to track who performed an action, especially when several people or groups are mentioned.
### Speaking and writing
Use accurate agreement across past, present and future, then link sentences naturally. Range helps only when communication remains clear.

[callout] Original exam-style task: Describe a school event in 90 words. Include what happened, what two groups did, what did not happen and what will happen next. This tests communication, not rule recitation.
## Integrated misconception clinic
Use the four-pass routine and state the reason for each repair.

TABLE: Draft | Improved version | Reason // وَصَلُوا الطُّلَّابُ ثُمَّ بَدَأُوا الدَّرْسُ. | وَصَلَ الطُّلَّابُ، ثُمَّ بَدَأُوا الدَّرْسَ. | First clause VSO singular verb; second subject is encoded plural; object accusative. // الطَّالِبَاتُ سَيَقْرَأُ الْمَقَالَةَ. | الطَّالِبَاتُ سَيَقْرَأْنَ الْمَقَالَةَ. | Subject-first feminine plural future agreement. // لَمْ كَتَبَ الْوَلَدَانِ الْوَاجِبَ. | لَمْ يَكْتُبِ الْوَلَدَانِ الْوَاجِبَ. | لَمْ + jussive; VSO singular masculine before dual. // الْحَافِلَاتُ وَصَلْنَ وَهُمْ سَرِيعُونَ. | الْحَافِلَاتُ وَصَلَتْ وَهِيَ سَرِيعَةٌ. | Non-human plural takes feminine singular agreement.
## Grammar game
Repair or extend each sentence while preserving its roles and agreement.
## Skills workshop التَّطْبِيقُ الْعَمَلِيُّ
Use the complete system in reading, speaking, writing and proofreading.
### 📖 Reading audit
Read a short event report. Underline every verb, box each explicit subject and draw a line to any attached object pronoun.
### 🗣️ Speaking transformation
Say one event first in VSO, then retell it with the subject first. Explain aloud how the verb changed.
### Final verbal-sentence performance
Write 120–140 Arabic words about a memorable day, school event, journey or community activity. Use deliberate sentence-order variety and accurate agreement.

[callout] Model: بَدَأَ الْيَوْمُ مُبَكِّرًا، وَوَصَلَ الطُّلَّابُ إِلَى الْمَدْرَسَةِ فِي السَّاعَةِ الثَّامِنَةِ. الطَّالِبَاتُ جَهَّزْنَ الْقَاعَةَ، أَمَّا الْمُعَلِّمُونَ فَرَاجَعُوا الْخُطَّةَ. لَمْ تَصِلِ الْحَافِلَاتُ فِي الْمَوْعِدِ، وَلَكِنَّهَا سَتَصِلُ قَرِيبًا.

[callout] Success checklist: Use at least six VSO sentences and four SVO sentences; include human masculine and feminine plurals, one dual, one non-human plural, past/present/future, one question or reported question, and two negative structures. Complete the four-pass edit before saving.
[callout] Paper route: Use two pen colours: one for VSO, one for SVO. Label agreement above every dual/plural sentence and rewrite any sentence whose order and verb form do not match.
## Final mastery check
Integrate order, agreement, tense, expansion and editing.
### What you can now do
- Choose VSO or SVO for a communicative reason.
- Expand a secure core with time, place, manner and cause.
- Maintain agreement through tense, question and negation changes.
- Edit verbal sentences using a repeatable four-pass routine.
Spaced revisit: Return in two or three days and complete the final check again without looking at the tables.
